pensamiento:
I'm checking each user story against the quality criteria one by one. The first three look fine: the role and action are clear, the story covers one timer feature, and there are no parentheses. The fourth gives a real reason, limiting how long the estimates get discussed. The fifth raises a doubt about whether "countdown timer" leans toward a solution, but I'm reading it as describing a need without imposing any technology, so it passes too.

I'm running the rest of the user stories through the same checks. QUS-006 through QUS-009 all pass: the timer criteria are measurable, nothing conflicts with the existing reset behaviour, and the story format matches the rest of the backlog. The independence and value checks also pass, and I'm now looking at whether the story is estimable, since it has no story points yet and the trigger for "start" is still unclear.

I'm finishing the checks on the invariant and definition-of-ready criteria. The independence, value and verifiability checks all pass, and the business rules are explicit enough to cover the restart and mid-countdown joins. The dependency and non-functional checks don't apply here, so I'm treating the story as ready and noting that the title is still empty.

Given the scope and the real-time sync, I'm leaning toward a 3-point estimate rather than 2. Next I'll look up the estimation scale and the reference stories to check that.

revision.historia_refinada: Como participante, quiero iniciar un temporizador de cuenta regresiva de dos minutos que todos los participantes puedan ver, para limitar el tiempo dedicado a discutir las estimaciones cuando considero que ya se habló lo suficiente.
criterios_aceptacion: Cualquier participante puede iniciar el temporizador; la cuenta regresiva parte de 2:00.
Todos los participantes ven el mismo tiempo restante, con una diferencia máxima de un segundo.
Cuando el temporizador llega a 0:00, todos los participantes ven el mensaje "Time is up"; la votación no se cierra automáticamente.
Si el temporizador ya está corriendo y alguien lo inicia de nuevo, se reinicia en 2:00.
